subject.title: Control UI: reintroduce AI tool-call purpose titles behind an explicit opt-in

question: Should Control UI purpose titles return as an opt-in core feature despite adding configuration, Gateway protocol, provider-egress, token-spend, and persistent-cache surfaces for decorative labels?
rationale: The explicit opt-in addresses the prior always-on behavior, but whether the readability benefit justifies these permanent core surfaces cannot be decided from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Accept the opt-in design
options.body: Review the linked PR for strict default-off behavior, bounded same-provider routing, authorization, upgrade safety, cache ownership, and live browser proof before landing.

options.title: Keep deterministic labels
options.body: Retain current-main rendering without model calls or cache writes and close the issue and linked PR with that explicit product decision.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in design
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR for strict default-off behavior, bounded same-provider routing, authorization, upgrade safety, cache ownership, and live browser proof before landing.
